Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick touch — we reviewed the high-level brief and leadership here is interested, but the week of Aug 2 is tight for both our CTO and VP of Product.

Two questions: can the demo be a shorter 30-minute executive walk-through focused on reliability and multi-region failover? Also, our CIO (Marcus) can only join during these windows: Tue Aug 3 between 09:00–10:30 PT or Wed Aug 4 between 13:00–15:00 PT.

If you can pull together a concise agenda and put a holder on one of those windows, I’ll confirm with Marcus and loop in any additional security folks.

Hi Lydia — thanks, that helps.

Short answer: yes, we can condense to a 30-minute executive walk-through highlighting:
- 7 min: key reliability differentiators (auto-fallback, prefix caching, deterministic SLAs)
- 10 min: multi-region failover demo (brief live failover scenario)
- 8 min: contract / capacity options and next steps
- 5 min: Q&A / follow-ups

I’ll propose two slots on your calendar: Tue Aug 3 09:30–10:00 PT and Wed Aug 4 13:30–14:00 PT. Marissa will own the invite and the brief deck; Rishi will be on standby for any procurement questions.

I’ve attached the streamlined agenda (ZenByte-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a quick map of recommended capacity for the pilot (MAP-snapshot-ZEN-4531.png).

If Marcus confirms one of the two, we’ll finalize the invite and include the security contact you reference.

Thanks —
Mina
